name: Australian Magpie
tip: Black and white with a white nape and a pale, black-tipped bill. Famous rich, warbling carol.

name: Laughing Kookaburra
tip: Big kingfisher with a heavy bill and dark eye-stripe. The laughing 'koo-koo-kaa-kaa' chorus at dawn and dusk.

name: Sulphur-crested Cockatoo
tip: Large white cockatoo with a yellow crest. Ear-splitting harsh screech.

name: Galah
tip: Pink chest and face, grey back, pale crown. Often feeds on lawns in flocks; high 'chet' calls.

name: Little Corella
tip: Smaller white cockatoo with a short crest, bare bluish eye-ring and a pinkish smudge between eye and bill.

name: Yellow-tailed Black-Cockatoo
tip: Large black cockatoo with yellow cheek patch and yellow tail panels. Slow, floppy flight; wailing 'wee-la' call.

name: Rainbow Lorikeet
tip: Blue head, red bill, orange-red chest, green back. Noisy, fast-flying flocks with screeching calls.

name: Crimson Rosella
tip: Deep crimson with blue cheeks and blue wings. Young birds are mostly green. Bell-like whistles.

name: Eastern Rosella
tip: Red head and chest with white cheeks, yellow belly, scalloped back. Compare Crimson Rosella's blue cheeks.

name: Australian King-Parrot
tip: Male has an all-red head and chest with green wings; female has a green head. Shrill 'carrack' call.

name: Noisy Miner
tip: Native grey honeyeater with a yellow bill, yellow patch behind the eye and black crown. Very noisy and aggressive.

name: Red Wattlebird
tip: Large streaky brown honeyeater with a small red wattle on the cheek and yellow belly. Harsh coughing 'chock' call.

name: Little Wattlebird
tip: Streaky brown honeyeater with no red wattle and a rufous wing patch in flight. Raucous cackling calls.

name: New Holland Honeyeater
tip: Black and white streaks, bright yellow wing panels, white eye. Busy in grevilleas and banksias.

name: Eastern Spinebill
tip: Small honeyeater with a long, fine curved bill, rufous throat and black crescents on the chest. Hovers at flowers.

name: Pied Currawong
tip: Black with a yellow eye, white tail tip and white wing patch. Heavy hooked bill; ringing 'curra-wong' call.

name: Australian Raven
tip: All glossy black with a white eye and shaggy throat hackles. Slow, wailing 'aah-aah-aaaah'.

name: Magpie-lark
tip: Small, slim black-and-white bird with a pale bill. Often walks on lawns. Pairs duet 'pee-wee'.

name: Grey Butcherbird
tip: Grey back, black cap, white throat and a hooked, blue-grey bill. Beautiful piping, mellow song.

name: Willie Wagtail
tip: Small black-and-white fantail with a black throat and white eyebrow. Constantly wags its tail side to side.

name: Spotted Dove
tip: Introduced. Pinkish-brown dove with a black collar full of white spots. Soft 'coo-coo-croo'.

name: Crested Pigeon
tip: Grey-brown pigeon with an upright, spiky black crest. Wings whistle when it takes off.

name: Common Myna
tip: Introduced. Brown body, black head, yellow bill, eye-skin and legs; white wing patches in flight. Compare Noisy Miner.

name: Red-whiskered Bulbul
tip: Introduced. Brown above, white below, tall black crest, red cheek patch and red under the tail.

name: Superb Fairywren
tip: Tiny with a cocked tail. Breeding male bright blue and black; females brown with a reddish eye area. Reeling trill.

name: Welcome Swallow
tip: Glossy blue-black back, rusty-orange throat and forehead, long forked tail. Swoops low over grass and water.

name: Silvereye
tip: Tiny olive-green bird with a bright white eye-ring and grey back. Moves in chattering flocks.

name: Grey Fantail
tip: Small grey bird with a long tail fanned open, white eyebrow and throat. Flits acrobatically after insects.

name: Spotted Pardalote
tip: Tiny with white spots on a black crown and wings, yellow throat. Repeated 'sleep, ba-by' whistle from the canopy.

name: Eastern Yellow Robin
tip: Grey back, bright yellow underparts. Clings sideways to tree trunks watching the ground.

name: Australian Golden Whistler
tip: Male has a black head, white throat with black band and golden-yellow chest. Loud whistle ending in a whip-crack.

name: Eastern Whipbird
tip: Olive-green with a black head, crest and white cheek patch. Unmistakable whip-crack call, often answered by its mate.

name: Eastern Koel
tip: Male glossy black with a red eye; female brown and spotted. Summer visitor with a rising 'coo-eee' all night.

name: Channel-billed Cuckoo
tip: Huge grey cuckoo with an enormous pale bill and long tail. Loud, raucous screams in spring.

name: Black-faced Cuckooshrike
tip: Soft grey with a black face and throat. Shuffles its wings after landing.

name: Tawny Frogmouth
tip: Grey, bark-patterned nightbird with a wide, frog-like bill. Roosts by day on branches pretending to be a stick. Low 'oom-oom-oom'.

name: Southern Boobook
tip: Small brown owl with pale spots and dark eye patches. The classic 'boo-book' night call.

name: Australian White Ibis
tip: Big white bird with a bare black head and long down-curved bill. The 'bin chicken'.

name: Masked Lapwing
tip: Brown back, white below, large yellow face wattles. Loud rattling alarm; swoops in breeding season.

name: Australian Brushturkey
tip: Large black bird with a bare red head and yellow (male) neck wattle. Rakes up huge mounds of leaf litter.

name: Superb Lyrebird
tip: Large brown ground bird; the male has a spectacular lyre-shaped tail. Master mimic of other birds' calls.

name: Satin Bowerbird
tip: Adult male glossy blue-black with violet eyes; females and young are green with scalloped undersides. Builds a bower decorated with blue objects.

name: Silver Gull
tip: Small white gull with grey wings, red bill and red legs. The everyday beach and chip-stealing gull.

name: Pacific Black Duck
tip: Mottled brown duck with a striped face (dark line through the eye) and green wing patch.

name: Australian Wood Duck
tip: Goose-like grey duck often grazing on lawns. Male has a dark brown head; female has two white face stripes.

name: Dusky Moorhen
tip: Dark grey waterbird with a red forehead shield and yellow-tipped red bill. Flicks its tail showing white sides.

name: Australasian Swamphen
tip: Large purple-blue waterbird with a heavy red bill and forehead shield and long red legs.

name: Australian Pelican
tip: Huge white-and-black waterbird with an enormous pink bill and throat pouch.

name: Little Pied Cormorant
tip: Small black-and-white cormorant with a short yellow bill. Often perches drying its wings by the water.

name: White-bellied Sea-Eagle
tip: Huge raptor with a white head and body and grey wings, soaring over harbours with wings in a shallow V.
